Concrete review: do not execute this proposal. Preserve every accepted requirement, public output, actual product visit, real workbook writer and root cleanup, but correct these implementation problems using existing forms.
1. Whole Browser results/snapshots must not enter global interpretation. For each complete observationSnapshot.pages collection, use mode extract with each exactly naming its bound input and sole result field; e.g. input pages, resultType {candidateArrays: array<array<Candidate>>}, each {input:pages,output:candidateArrays}. Every page produces one array of only the observed candidate facts needed by the immediate decision, possibly [] after checking absence. Use the existing one-level typed flatten over candidateArrays before global interpretation. Keep full source observations separate; no raw pages/envelopes in global decisions. Initial consent needs observed actionable controls and blocker text; search selection needs observed product URLs/names and blocker text; product detail needs observed name/description/price candidates and blocker text. Do not emit all unrelated records or synthesize classifications/defaults inside extraction. Preserve every source page and original completeness metadata.
2. Optional consent must be a conditional, not a required operation: no banner means continue with the original complete snapshot. If an observed consent control exists, click its reference with literal requestedAction=activate, then obtain a fresh complete snapshot. Never use follow to pretend a link is a consent control. Export matching explicit typed interfaces from both branches; use deterministic bindings to select observed data. Remove interpretation that rewrites/copies the entire snapshot into made-up content.
3. Each selected product must still be visited, at most ten sequentially. Product name/description/price must come from that visited page, not search-list fallback. Missing values/blockers remain explicit. Give workbook formatting only the declared foreach product output, not the whole loop result. Keep the real writer and its filePath output, rowCount/completeness, and root Browser cleanup unchanged in purpose. No larger limits, fabricated references or completeness.
